,linkVideo.id as linkVideo_id, linkVideo.video_name as linkVideo_video_name, linkVideo.video_desc as linkVideo_video_desc, linkVideo.origin_course_id as linkVideo_origin_course_id

mapper.select:
SELECT
,
from gc_event e left join sys_file linkFile on e.link_file_id = linkFile.id left join gc_video linkVideo on e.link_video_id =linkVideo.id left join gc_subject course ON course.id = linkVideo.origin_course_id left join gc_event futurePreEvent on e.future_pre_event_id=futurePreEvent.id left join gc_user_answer answer on answer.event_id=futurePreEvent.id and answer.user_id = #{userId} where e.id = #{id} order by e.create_time

SELECT
,
from gc_event e left join sys_file linkFile on e.link_file_id = linkFile.id left join gc_video linkVideo on e.link_video_id =linkVideo.id left join gc_subject course ON course.id = linkVideo.origin_course_id left join gc_event futurePreEvent on e.future_pre_event_id=futurePreEvent.id left join gc_user_event ue on ue.event_id = e.id left join gc_user_answer answer on answer.event_id=futurePreEvent.id where e.video_id = #{vid} and ue.master_id=#{masterId} or (e.upload_type = #{type} and e.video_id=#{vid}) order by e.create_time

SELECT
,
from gc_event e left join sys_file linkFile on e.link_file_id = linkFile.id left join gc_video linkVideo on e.link_video_id =linkVideo.id left join gc_subject course ON course.id = linkVideo.origin_course_id left join gc_event futurePreEvent on e.future_pre_event_id=futurePreEvent.id left join gc_user_event ue on ue.event_id=e.id left join gc_user_answer answer on futurePreEvent.id=answer.event_id where e.video_id = #{vid} and ue.user_id=#{userId} and ue.master_id=#{masterId} or (e.upload_type = #{type} and e.video_id=#{vid}) order by e.create_time

select
,CASE WHEN an.answer_json is null THEN 0 ELSE 1 END as myAnswerFlag,an.id as ua_id,an.answer_json as ua_answerJson, an.update_time as ua_updateTime from gc_event AS e LEFT JOIN gc_user_event AS ue ON ue.event_id = e.id LEFT JOIN gc_user u on e.upload_user=u.id LEFT JOIN gc_user_info ui on ui.id=u.info_id left join gc_user_answer an on an.event_id=e.id and an.user_id = #{uid} where e.event_type !=4
and video_id in
#{vid}
AND (ue.user_id = #{uid} OR e.upload_type != 2) ORDER BY e.event_time asc

SELECT e.id, e.video_id, e.event_time, e.event_title, e.time_limit, e.event_type, e.ext, e.upload_type, e.upload_user FROM gc_event e LEFT JOIN gc_user_event ue ON ue.event_id = e.id LEFT JOIN gc_user u ON e.upload_user = u.id where 1=1
and video_id in
#{vid}
AND ue.user_id = #{userId} and ue.master_id=#{masterId} AND e.upload_type = 2

select s.sub_id from gc_event e LEFT JOIN gc_video v on e.video_id=v.id LEFT JOIN gc_subject s on s.id=v.sub_id WHERE e.id=#{eid}
GROUP BY s.sub_id
select e.id from gc_event AS e LEFT JOIN gc_user_event AS ue ON ue.event_id = e.id where video_id = #{vid} AND (ue.user_id = #{uid} OR e.upload_type != 2)

select
from gc_event AS e LEFT JOIN gc_user_event AS ue ON ue.event_id = e.id LEFT JOIN gc_user u on e.upload_user=u.id LEFT JOIN gc_user_info ui on ui.id=u.info_id where video_id = #{vid} AND (ue.user_id = #{uid} OR e.upload_type != 2) order by event_time asc
select e.id from gc_event e LEFT JOIN gc_video v ON v.id=e.video_id LEFT JOIN gc_subject s ON s.id=v.sub_id where s.master_id=#{masterId}
select * from gc_event where type=#{type} and video_id=#{vid}

select an.answer_json as answerJson,e.id as id,e.event_type,e.ext,e.video_id as videoId from gc_subject s left join gc_subject s2 on s2.fid = s.id left join gc_video v on s2.id = v.sub_id left join gc_event e on e.video_id = v.id left join gc_user_event ue on ue.event_id = e.id and ue.user_id = #{userId} left join gc_user_answer an on an.event_id = e.id and an.user_id = #{userId} where s.id = #{subjectId} and e.event_type!=4 and s.master_id = #{masterId} and ((e.upload_type = 2 and ue.id is not null ) or(e.upload_type = 1 )) and e.id is not null
